# Offline display dependencies

Three.js 0.186.1 and KaTeX 0.19.0 are pinned from the npm registry, with package
integrity and per-file SHA-256 records in manifest.json. Their upstream MIT
licenses are retained in each directory. No third-party request is needed to
replay or read the exported workspace. Scientific geometry is generated from
recorded numbers by ORBEX-A, not by these dependencies.

Upstream documentation: https://threejs.org/manual/en/installation.html and
https://katex.org/docs/autorender .
